# ref 0.2.4

A major performance, architecture, and workflow release introducing SQLite v4 pushdown with FTS5 trigram search, long-session virtualization, and session-bound pinning across Running and History, interactive runtime backend switching with lazy local server startup, TUI empty startup and detach, immediate LLM retry, persistent Stash Groups with split-view direct-parent filtering, crisp unblurred split-view transitions, and a 2-state desktop floating ball in `ref-gui`.

## Before you update

- **Protocol version 6 & SQLite schema v4.** `ref-server`, `ref`, `ref-gui`, and `ref-web` now speak wire protocol v6 (`PROTOCOL_VERSION = 6`), and `ref-server` upgrades its SQLite database losslessly from v0/v1/v2/v3 to schema v4 (`sessions_fts` FTS5 trigram index, `messages.layout_meta`, `session_groups` / `session_group_members`, `sessions.stashed_resume`, and `sessions.pinned_at` + `sessions_pinned` index). Update all binaries together and restart any running `0.2.3` `ref-server` (`ref-server --stop` works across protocol versions; a local `ref-server` started automatically by a client exits once all old client windows close).

## Crisp Split-View Transitions (`ref-gui` & `ref-web`)

- **Zero content blur during layout resizes.** Removed `MultiEffect` blur and `resizeFadeOpacity` fade transitions on `Tile.qml` during split-tile layout resizes and sidebar expand/collapse animations, keeping `settledLayoutWidth` / `paneWidthFloor` / `layoutWidth` width stabilization so text stays sharp without reflow jitter. Verified zero `blur` or `filter` transitions on tiles or content in WebUI (`SplitView.vue` and `SplitTile.vue`).

## SQLite v3 Pushdown, FTS5 Search & Long-Session Virtualization (`ref-server`, `ref`, `ref-gui`, `ref-web`)

- **Full SQL pushdown.** Removed full-table and full-session loads across `list_sessions`, `resolve_history_id`, `list_history`, and single-row `get_image` (using indexed `WHERE session_id = ?1 AND id = ?2 LIMIT 1` lookups instead of `store.load()`).
- **SQLite v3 indexes & FTS5 trigram search.** Added descending/collation indexes (`sessions_updated`, `sessions_cwd`, `sessions_parent`, `sessions_name_nocase`) and the `sessions_fts` FTS5 trigram virtual table maintained by `sessions_ai` / `sessions_au` / `sessions_ad` triggers (with an `INSTR` fallback for `< 3`-character queries), verified with `EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN` assertions.
- **Server active window & client-side configurable sliding window.** `SessionState` keeps only the active window (`window_start_seq` anchored at the latest `Compaction` message) in memory and serves historical ranges on demand via `Request::Messages` `[start_seq, end_seq)` paging together with `MessageLayoutMeta` / `PartLayoutMeta`. Clients locally compute `columnWidth`-aware placeholder heights for true-length scrollbars, enforce a configurable sliding window (`messageWindowSize` in `gui.json`, WebUI `ref.settings`, and `tui.json`, exposed in GUI/WebUI *Settings* → *Message window* with `±50` steppers + free numeric input and TUI `/window [N|reset]`; default `1000` with `500` page/margin, no upper limit, and `0` = unlimited / auto-load all history) alongside decoded image cache eviction, debounce fast scrubbing by `80 ms` with stale-response cancellation, and render structured skeleton placeholders (`SkeletonBlock.qml` / `SkeletonBlock.vue`) with anchor-preserved fade-in.

## Interactive Backend Switching & Lazy Local Backend (`ref`, `ref-gui`, `ref-web`)

- **Resolution order & per-client persistence.** Backend target resolution follows `CLI --server / --token` (or `--mock`) > persisted client default (`gui.json`, `<state_dir>/tui.json` written with `0600` on Unix, and WebUI `localStorage` key `ref.backend.v1`) > local `Auto`.
- **Runtime hot-switching across all clients.** Exposed *Backend* in Settings, *Switch Backend…* on the disconnected banner, and `/backend` (`/server`) + `Ctrl+P` command palette with *Switch temporarily*, *Save as default*, and *Restore local default*. Switching cleanly cancels in-flight requests/subscriptions, closes the previous socket, clears cached session/config/directory state, and runs a fresh `Hello` handshake.
- **`ref-web` sealed control channel & lazy local startup.** `crates/web/src/tunnel.rs` now exchanges sealed `connect_upstream` / `upstream_ready` control frames before connecting upstream (with direct WebSocket mode via `?server=` or `VITE_REF_URL`). When the resolved startup target is explicit or remote, GUI, TUI, and `ref-web` completely skip local `instances` discovery and `ref-server` spawning until switching back to `Auto`.

## TUI Empty Startup & Detach (`ref`)

- **Manual startup & `DraftConfig`.** `ref` now starts on the empty welcome screen (`current = None`) unless `-s`, `-c` (with matching history; warns via toast without creating a blank session if none), or `-p` is passed. `DraftConfig` (`agent`, `model`, `variant`) and the separate `App.cwd` directory can be configured via `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` / `Ctrl+T` / `/agent` / `/model` / `/variant` / `/cd` before the first prompt, while `/new` creates a session immediately.
- **Detach to welcome screen.** Running `/detach` (`/background`, `/leave`), clicking or pressing `Enter` on the active sidebar session row, and closing the current or last session all return to the welcome screen without auto-attaching another session or exiting TUI.

## Immediate LLM Retry (`ref-server`, `ref`, `ref-gui`, `ref-web`)

- **`Request::RetryNow` wake-up.** Added `Request::RetryNow` to wake `SessionStatus::Retrying` backoff sleeps immediately while preserving attempt counts across GUI (`StatusLine.qml`), WebUI (`StatusLine.vue` clickable retry button with hover state and tooltip), and TUI (`/retry` command + clickable `Hit::RetryNow` status row).
- **Configurable upstream retry-delay sources.** Added `retry.respect_headers`, `retry.respect_body_fields`, and `retry.parse_error_text` (all default `true`) with strict `header > body_field > text` precedence and toggles in GUI/WebUI general settings, allowing account pools and relays to ignore forwarded inner cooldown text or override it via gateway headers.

## Stash Groups & Split Direct-Parent Filter (`ref-server`, `ref`, `ref-gui`, `ref-web`)

- **Persistent Stash Groups with safe resume.** Added `session_groups` and `session_group_members` tables in SQLite v3 together with `stashed_resume` (`StashResumeKind`: `none`, `continue`, or `reprompt` with `pending_queue` preservation). Restoring always opens sessions into the background (`attached == 0`) and either continues interrupted runs or re-prompts pending permission/question confirmations safely; locked groups preserve their structure while unlocked groups auto-clean on full or last-member restore, synced live via `ServerFrame::GroupsChanged`.
- **Sidebar entry & two-column Stash manager.** Added a symmetric `36×36` sidebar stash button (`stash-20` / `stash-count-20` with embedded group count) to the left of *New session*: left-click stashes all live sessions (or opens the dialog when none are live), while right-click and `/stashed` open the two-column drag-and-drop `StashDialog` (or TUI `Dialog::Stash`) featuring creator color coding, within-group reordering, cross-group move/copy, drag-to-Running restore, drag-outside-columns removal, and group merge.
- **Split-view direct-parent creator filter & instant filter switching.** Added `All`, `User-created`, and `By <parent>` filtering (matching direct `info.parent`) via a centered animated topbar capsule in GUI and WebUI (plus tile header context-menu quick filters) and a footer pill + `f` key in TUI. Live background sessions stay attached and their tile views stay warm while `watchAll(true)` is active, eliminating detach/re-attach snapshot resets and ResizeObserver layout thrashing during filter switches.
- **Session-bound pinning across Running & History.** Added `SessionInfo.pinned_at`, `Request::SetPinned`, and `ServerFrame::HistoryChanged` so pinning is bound to the session itself and automatically persists across running, closed history, and stash/resume with real-time 3-client sync. Pinned sessions sort first (`pinned_at DESC`) with per-group drag-reordering bounds in GUI and WebUI (`pin-16` icon, inline pin button, and context menu) and `✦` badges, `Ctrl+K` in `/sessions`, and `/pin` in TUI.
- **Conflict-free root & creator palette colors.** Unified GUI, WebUI, and TUI split tiles and Stash dialogs onto deterministic least-used linear-probing palette assignment so concurrent roots/creators avoid color collisions.

## Floating Ball 2-State Mode (`ref-gui`)

- **Single-window orb and mini panel.** Added a topbar `float-20` toggle (`Ctrl+Shift+F`, `/float`, `/floating`) switching `ref-gui` into a 2-state always-on-top floating ball: a `56×56` compact orb with hover highlight feedback, embedded count, and aggregate status breathing dot that expands in place (without spawning a separate overlay window) into a `380×520` mini panel. Expanding with no foreground session shows the running sessions list without auto-attaching any session; when a session is open, the header includes a *Move to background* button (`chat-list`), compact session switcher, return to large window, collapse to ball, and busy-guarded exit, plus notification-click restore to the full window.
- **Multi-monitor anchoring, always-on-top flags, & Wayland limits.** Persists `{ screenName, x, y }` under `floatingBall` in `gui.json`, uses `QScreen::availableGeometry()` to anchor expansions inward and clamp bounds across screens, and uses platform-aware stays-on-top window flags (`Qt::Tool` restricted to Windows so macOS/X11 remain visible and on top across focus changes). On Linux Wayland, compositors restrict client global-coordinate read/write and may ignore stays-on-top hints; dragging falls back to `startSystemMove()`.

## Other Improvements & Reliability

- **Tolerant `edit` stale-tag remapping.** `edit` line remapping (`trim_end_lines`) now tolerates trailing spaces and tabs, matching `hashline::file_hash`.
- **Concise tool prompts & compaction todo retention.** Trimmed user-facing UI hints from `todo`, `compact_context`, and `purpose` tool descriptions (and removed the single `in_progress` constraint from `todo`), and preserved current todo items (annotated with a staleness note) in compaction summaries.
- **Test stability & sanitizer hygiene.** Fixed the `crates/web` `unreachable_backend_closes_the_tab_with_a_fixed_reason` dead-port race and flushed QML singleton/component caches before `QQmlEngine` teardown in `tst_main_window`.
- **Split-view foreground preservation (`ref` & `ref-web`).** Entering split view now keeps the hidden current session foreground-attached (matching `ref-gui`), avoiding redundant detach/re-attach round-trips when toggling split view.
- **Unified HiDPI `Canvas` shimmer (`ref-gui`).** Removed the 0×0 `ShaderEffectSource` + `MultiEffect` GPU branch in `ShimmerText.qml` (which rendered blank/static shimmer on GPU backends) and unified all backends on the HiDPI `Canvas` sweep path.
- **Conversation scroll stability (`ref-gui`).** Switched wheel gliding to relative `wheelRemaining` deltas, preserved exact `(seq, rowOffsetInSeq, pixelOffset)` anchors across both materialization and eviction (skipping `delayRemove` exit animations during window mutations), eliminated inter-row gap `-1` clamping in `reportVisibleRange`, and debounced visible-range updates off the per-pixel scroll hot path.

## Verification & Known Risks

- **GitHub Actions CI (9/9 jobs passed):** `fmt + clippy` (Ubuntu), `web (types, lint, tests, generated files)` (Ubuntu), `test` (`ubuntu-24.04`, `macos-15`, `windows-2025`), `gui` (`ubuntu-24.04`, `windows-2025`, `macos-15-intel`), and `gui tests with ASan and UBSan` (Ubuntu, where 41/42 GUI tests pass with `detect_leaks=1` and only `tst_main_window` runs with `detect_leaks=0` due to Qt 6.12's internal `QQmlPropertyCapture` / `QQuickWindow` secondary-window teardown cycle).
- **Unverified before tag CI / desktop smoke:** Interactive desktop windowing and Linux Wayland floating-ball compositor behavior, native IME and DPI scaling, and the 6-target `release.yml` packaging archives.

# ref 0.2.4（简体中文）

0.2.4 是聚焦性能、架构与多端工作流的重磅版本，带来 SQLite v4 查询全下沉、FTS5 三元组检索、长会话按页加载与滑动窗口回收、跨运行中与历史的会话级置顶同步、全三端交互式后端热切换与本地后端懒加载、TUI 空启动与取消选中、LLM 退避等待立刻重试、持久化暂存组与分屏直接父会话筛选、分屏零模糊平滑过渡，以及 `ref-gui` 两态悬浮球模式。

## 更新前请注意

- **通信协议升至第 6 版，SQLite 升至 v4 架构。** `ref-server`、`ref`、`ref-gui` 与 `ref-web` 现使用第 6 版协议（`PROTOCOL_VERSION = 6`），`ref-server` 会将 SQLite 数据库从 v0/v1/v2/v3 无损自动迁移至 v4（新增 `sessions_fts` FTS5 三元组索引表、`messages.layout_meta`、`session_groups` / `session_group_members`、`sessions.stashed_resume` 及 `sessions.pinned_at` / `sessions_pinned` 索引）。升级时请一并更新全部二进制文件，并重启运行中的 `0.2.3` 版 `ref-server`（`ref-server --stop` 支持跨协议版本执行；由客户端自动拉起的本地 `ref-server` 会在旧版窗口全部关闭后自动退出）。

## 清晰的分屏过渡（`ref-gui` 与 `ref-web`）

- **移除卡片内容模糊过渡。** 移除 `Tile.qml` 在布局缩放及侧边栏展开/收起期间的 `MultiEffect` 模糊效果与 `resizeFadeOpacity` 渐隐过渡，保留 `settledLayoutWidth` / `paneWidthFloor` / `layoutWidth` 列宽稳定机制，确保文字全程锐利无重排抖动；同时完成 WebUI 分屏卡片（`SplitView.vue`、`SplitTile.vue`）核查，确认无任何 `blur` 或 `filter` 内容模糊过渡。

## SQLite v3 下沉、FTS5 检索与长会话虚拟化（`ref-server`、`ref`、`ref-gui`、`ref-web`）

- **查询与图片读取全下沉 SQL。** 消除 `list_sessions`、`resolve_history_id`、`list_history` 与单张图片读取 `get_image` 中的全表及整会话加载，非活跃会话图片改为按 `WHERE session_id = ?1 AND id = ?2 LIMIT 1` 直查索引。
- **SQLite v3 索引与 FTS5 三元组全文检索。** 补齐 `sessions_updated`、`sessions_cwd`、`sessions_parent`、`sessions_name_nocase` 索引，新增由 `sessions_ai` / `sessions_au` / `sessions_ad` 触发器自动同步的 `sessions_fts` FTS5 trigram 虚表（不足 3 个字符的查询自动回退 `INSTR`），并通过 `EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN` 断言验证索引命中。
- **服务端活跃窗口与前端可配置滑动窗口。** 服务端 `SessionState` 仅常驻自最近一次 `Compaction` 起的活跃窗口（`window_start_seq`），通过 `Request::Messages` 的 `[start_seq, end_seq)` 区间分页与 `MessageLayoutMeta` / `PartLayoutMeta` 按需供给历史消息。前端结合实际 `columnWidth` 纯本地估算占位高度以渲染真实比例滚动条，支持自定义滑动窗口大小（持久化在 `gui.json`、WebUI `ref.settings` 与 `tui.json` 的 `messageWindowSize`，提供 GUI/WebUI *设置* → *消息窗口* 的 `±50` 步进与自由输入以及 TUI `/window [N|reset]`；默认 `1000` 条、每页/缓冲 `500` 条，不设上限，`0` 表示不限制并自动加载全部历史）并同步清理被回收消息的解码图片缓存，对快速拖动施加 `80 ms` 防抖并丢弃过期响应，同时使用与消息结构匹配的结构化骨架占位（`SkeletonBlock.qml` / `SkeletonBlock.vue`）配合锚定防跳动淡入。

## 交互式切换后端与本地后端按需懒加载（`ref`、`ref-gui`、`ref-web`）

- **配置优先级与独立存储。** 连接目标严格按 `CLI --server / --token`（或 `--mock`） > 各端持久化默认后端（`gui.json`、Unix 下 `0600` 权限的 `<state_dir>/tui.json`、WebUI `localStorage` 键 `ref.backend.v1`） > 默认本地 `Auto` 解析。
- **全三端运行时热切换。** 在*设置*「后端 / Backend」分区、断连横幅*切换后端…（Switch Backend…）*按钮以及 `/backend`（`/server`）与 `Ctrl+P` 命令面板提供*临时切换*、*保存为默认*与*还原本地默认*三种操作；切换时安全取消在途请求与订阅、关闭旧连接、清空会话/配置/目录缓存，并重建连接执行 `Hello` 握手。
- **`ref-web` 加密控制信道与本地后端懒加载。** `crates/web/src/tunnel.rs` 在建立上游连接前通过加密信道交互 `connect_upstream` / `upstream_ready` 控制帧（同时支持 `?server=` / `VITE_REF_URL` 直连 WebSocket 模式）。当启动解析出的目标为显式或远程后端时，GUI、TUI 与 `ref-web` 在启动阶段完全跳过本地 `instances` 扫描与 `ref-server` 拉起。

## TUI 空启动与取消选中（`ref`）

- **空欢迎页启动与 `DraftConfig`。** 除显式传入 `-s`、`-c`（命中历史时；未命中则弹出警告而不新建空白会话）或 `-p` 外，`ref` 默认停留在空欢迎页（`current = None`）。发送首条消息前可通过 `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` / `Ctrl+T` / `/agent` / `/model` / `/variant` / `/cd` 调整 `DraftConfig`（`agent`、`model`、`variant`）与独立保存的 `App.cwd` 目录，`/new` 仍可立即新建空会话。
- **取消选中回到欢迎页。** 执行 `/detach`（`/background`、`/leave`）、点击或按 `Enter` 选中侧栏当前活跃会话行，以及关闭当前或最后一个会话，均会回到空欢迎页而不再自动切到其他会话或退出 TUI。

## LLM 退避等待立刻重试（`ref-server`、`ref`、`ref-gui`、`ref-web`）

- **`Request::RetryNow` 唤醒退避等待。** 新增 `Request::RetryNow`，在 `SessionStatus::Retrying` 期间立即唤醒退避睡眠进入下一轮重试（保留既有 `attempt` 计数）。GUI（`StatusLine.qml`）、WebUI（`StatusLine.vue` 带悬停高亮与提示的可点击重试按钮）与 TUI（`/retry` 命令及状态行可点击 `Hit::RetryNow` 热区）均已接入。
- **可配置上游重试等待提示来源。** 新增 `retry.respect_headers`、`retry.respect_body_fields` 与 `retry.parse_error_text` 配置项（默认均为 `true`）及 GUI/WebUI 通用设置开关，严格按 `header > body_field > text`（响应头 > 响应体字段 > 错误文本）优先级选取等待时间，方便号池或中转网关屏蔽透传的内层长冷却文本或通过响应头覆盖。

## 暂存组与分屏按直接父会话筛选（`ref-server`、`ref`、`ref-gui`、`ref-web`）

- **持久化暂存组与安全续跑。** SQLite v3 新增 `session_groups` / `session_group_members` 表与 `stashed_resume` 状态（`StashResumeKind`：`none` / `continue` / `reprompt`，并完整保留 `pending_queue`）。还原统一进入后台（`attached == 0`），自动续跑被中断的工作或重新发起待处理的授权/问答确认而不跳过权限；已锁定组保留结构，未锁定组在整组或最后一条还原后自动清理，并通过 `ServerFrame::GroupsChanged` 实时同步多端。
- **侧栏入口与双栏拖拽暂存管理。** 侧栏新建会话按钮左侧新增与右侧目录按钮对称的 `36×36` 暂存按钮（`stash-20` / 居中内嵌组数的 `stash-count-20`）：左键一键暂存全部运行中会话（无运行中会话时打开弹窗），右键及 `/stashed` 打开双栏拖拽 `StashDialog`（TUI 为 `Dialog::Stash`），支持创建者配色区分、组内排序、跨组移动/复制、拖入左侧“运行中”区域恢复、拖至两栏之外移除与整组合并。
- **分屏直接父会话筛选与无卡顿切换。** 支持按 `All`、`User-created` 与 `By <parent>`（精确匹配直接 `info.parent`）筛选：GUI 与 WebUI 在顶部栏居中位置以平滑动画展示筛选胶囊（同时支持分块标题右键快捷筛选），TUI 在分屏底栏显示筛选胶囊并支持 `f` 键切换；分屏期间筛选切换保留后台会话附着与卡片实例（WebUI 同步合并 `ResizeObserver` 测量与列宽缓存清空），消除反复 detach/re-attach 快照重置与动画卡顿。
- **跨运行中与历史的会话级置顶（三端实时同步）。** 新增 `SessionInfo.pinned_at`、`Request::SetPinned` 与 `ServerFrame::HistoryChanged` 广播：置顶状态绑定会话本身，在运行中、关闭进入历史与暂存/还原间自动沿用；列表按置顶优先（`pinned_at DESC`）排序，GUI 与 WebUI 侧栏支持 `pin-16` 行内图钉按钮、右键菜单及分组内拖拽钳位，TUI 侧栏与 `/sessions` 展示等宽 `✦` 标记并支持 `Ctrl+K` 快捷置顶与 `/pin` 命令。
- **全三端无撞色根任务/创建者配色。** GUI、WebUI 与 TUI 的分屏卡片及暂存弹窗统一采用“排序去重 + 最少使用线性探测”无冲突槽位分配，避免多并发根任务/创建者撞色。

## 桌面 GUI 悬浮球两态模式（`ref-gui`）

- **单窗口球体与迷你面板。** 顶部栏新增 `float-20` 切换按钮（`Ctrl+Shift+F`、`/float`、`/floating`），进入始终置顶的两态悬浮球：`56×56` 圆形球体（支持悬停高亮样式、内嵌会话数与综合状态呼吸灯），左键单击由同一窗口原地展开为 `380×520` 迷你面板；若当前无前台会话则展示运行中会话列表（不会自动将后台会话拉入前台），打开会话后顶栏提供*挂到后台*按钮（`chat-list`）、紧凑会话切换器、返回大窗口、收起为悬浮球及带忙碌确认的退出按钮；悬浮期间点击系统通知自动还原大窗口并打开目标会话。
- **多显示器向内展开、置顶标志与 Wayland 限制。** 位置以 `floatingBall` 字段持久化到 `gui.json`，基于 `QScreen::availableGeometry()` 计算向内展开方向与屏幕边界钳位，并按平台设置置顶标志（仅 Windows 附带 `Qt::Tool`，避免 macOS/X11 失焦隐藏或层级异常）。受 Linux Wayland 协议限制，客户端无法读写全局坐标且部分合成器可能忽略置顶标志，拖动将回退为 `startSystemMove()`。

## 其他改进与稳定性修复

- **`edit` 过期标签行重映射兼容行尾空白。** `edit` 工具行重映射新增 `trim_end_lines`，忽略行尾空格与制表符差异以与 `hashline::file_hash` 保持一致。
- **精简工具描述与压缩摘要保留待办。** 从 `todo`、`compact_context` 与 `purpose` 工具描述中移除面向用户界面的提示（并取消 `todo` 中仅保留一项 `in_progress` 的约束），并在上下文压缩摘要中附带当前待办清单（标注可能已过期或失准）。
- **测试稳定性与内存检查修复。** 修复 `crates/web` `unreachable_backend_closes_the_tab_with_a_fixed_reason` 端口竞争问题，并在 `tst_main_window` `QQmlEngine` 析构前显式清理 QML 单例与组件缓存。
- **分屏模式保留隐藏当前会话的前台附着状态（`ref` 与 `ref-web`）。** 进入分屏视图时保持被隐藏的当前会话维持前台附着（与 `ref-gui` 行为一致），避免切换分屏时产生多余的分离/重连往返。
- **统一 HiDPI `Canvas` 扫光渲染（`ref-gui`）。** 移除 `ShimmerText.qml` 中 `0×0` `ShaderEffectSource` + `MultiEffect` 的 GPU 分支（该分支在 GPU 后端下会导致扫光透明/静止），所有后端统一采用 HiDPI `Canvas` 扫光路径。
- **长会话滚动稳定性修复（`ref-gui`）。** 滚轮平滑动效改为相对余量 `wheelRemaining`，在 materialize 与 evict 两侧均执行精确行级 `(seq, rowOffsetInSeq, pixelOffset)` 锚点恢复并跳过变更期 `delayRemove` 退出动画，修复行间距 `-1` 误报第 0 行/末行并防抖可视区间上报，消除长会话前后频繁跳动。

## 验证与已知风险

- **GitHub Actions CI（9/9 任务全部通过）：** `fmt + clippy`（Ubuntu）、`web (types, lint, tests, generated files)`（Ubuntu）、`test`（`ubuntu-24.04`、`macos-15`、`windows-2025`）、`gui`（`ubuntu-24.04`、`windows-2025`、`macos-15-intel`），以及 `gui tests with ASan and UBSan`（Ubuntu：42 项 GUI 测试中 41 项在 `detect_leaks=1` 下通过，仅 `tst_main_window` 因 Qt 6.12 内部 `QQmlPropertyCapture` / `QQuickWindow` 次级窗口析构循环而单独设置 `detect_leaks=0`）。
- **待标签 CI / 桌面真机验证项：** 原生交互式桌面窗口与 Linux Wayland 悬浮球合成器行为、原生输入法与 DPI 缩放表现，以及 6 个目标平台的 `release.yml` 发布打包产物。
